column4: No-op debug/log sink: function body is exactly single RET (entry==ret, no args consumed); 1,672 direct call sites, 1,497 (89.53%) immediately preceded by PUSH imm32 and 1,492 resolves to printable C strings, versus 5.14% push-imm32 baseline over 81,715 direct calls; examples include COPYPROTECTION markers and many subsystem diagnostics.
